Class AmwpAwareShell

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.ssh.AmwpAwareShell
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.sshd.server.command.Command, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectErrorStreamAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectInputStreamAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectOutputStreamAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectStreamsAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandLifecycle
public class AmwpAwareShell extends Object implements org.apache.sshd.server.command.Command
The AmwpAwareShell class is the mux around ChatShell pipes. The shell is an SSH Command. It holds the inner command, the AmwpFacade, the Lamina pool, and the SSH user name. A client that sends an AMWP init frame is muxed onto channel A and channel T. A client that does not send that frame stays a raw PTY. OpenSSH stays a raw PTY. start(ChannelSession, Environment) returns before the peek, so the client can send the init frame. destroy(ChannelSession) unbinds the console and closes the mux.

clayl (2026-09-02)

    • AmwpAwareShell

      public AmwpAwareShell(org.apache.sshd.server.command.Command inner, AmwpFacade facade, Lamina lamina, String sshUser)
      The constructor stores the inner command and does not start it. A null user name is stored as empty. The mux flag starts false. The closed flag starts false.
      Parameters:
      inner - The inner command is the ChatShell.
      facade - The facade is the Scope A handler.
      lamina - The lamina is the pool that runs Lane.SSH_IO.
      sshUser - The user name is the SSH user, or null.

    • start

      public void start(org.apache.sshd.server.channel.ChannelSession channel, org.apache.sshd.server.Environment env) throws IOException
      The start method stores the channel and returns before the peek. The input stream is wrapped in an AmwpPeekStream. A LaminaTask on Lane.SSH_IO named aetheris-amwp-hs runs handshakeThenStart(). A blocking peek inside this method would stall open().verify(), which waits for start.
      Specified by:
      start in interface org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandLifecycle
      Parameters:
      channel - The channel is the SSH channel session.
      env - The environment is the SSH environment.
      Throws:
      IOException - The method declares IOException.

    • destroy

      public void destroy(org.apache.sshd.server.channel.ChannelSession channel)
      The destroy method closes the mux and the inner command. The closed flag is set first. AmwpFacade.bindConsole(String, AmwpFacade.AmwpReplySink) is called with a null sink for this user. A keepalive timer is cancelled. The demux thread is interrupted. The channel T pipe and the peek stream are closed. A close failure is ignored. inner.destroy is called, and a failure there is ignored.
      Specified by:
      destroy in interface org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandLifecycle
      Parameters:
      channel - The channel is the SSH channel session.
